items.claim: Miles Johns has been fighting in the UFC since 2019.
items.quote: Miles Johns has been fighting in the UFC since 2019

items.claim: Jesse Rosas is making his UFC debut and has not fought high-level competition.
items.quote: this kid's about to get his ass beat by Miles Johns... against Miles Johns who's a [ __ ] unit, I don't think he's going to be able to hurt him.

items.claim: Richie Miranda lacks good boxing and doesn't have pop on his shots.
items.quote: I'm watching his striking and he just he his boxing's not good and he doesn't have pop on his shots.

items.claim: Manel Sousa is too explosive for Richie Miranda and will likely get a TKO finish.
items.quote: I think Manel Sousa is just going to be able to clip him, hurt him and probably get him out of there, guys.

items.claim: Billy Ray Goff hasn't fought in over a year.
items.quote: Billy Ray Goff hasn't fought in over a year

items.claim: Ty Miller has a significant height and reach advantage at 6'2" with a 77.5-inch reach.
items.quote: Ty Miller could do it all. 6'2, 77 and 1/2 inch reach.

items.claim: Darren Elkins has absorbed a massive amount of damage and has too many miles on him in his 40s.
items.quote: DARREN ELKINS has a lot of miles on the vehicle... Darren Elkins has 400,000 miles on a [ __ ] car.

items.claim: Amanda Lemos does not do well against good grapplers and struggles with takedowns.
items.quote: Amanda Lemos is old. She's 39. And she doesn't do well against good grapplers. You could check the Tatiana Suarez fight.
